Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 115. Category: feat. Trained Feature Feats.

Requires Ultra Ego
When you would take damage, you may spend your
reaction to store the damage within. Until the end of
your next turn, you write down the amount of damage
you’ve taken. The next time you would deal damage, you
may add the damage that you’ve taken onto your
damage
